title: ROME
753 BC TO NOW

cards.title: The Etruscan kings
lines: They drain the marshes between the hills. The Forum is born.

cards.title: No more kings
lines: The last king is driven out. Rome becomes a republic.

cards.title: The Gauls sack Rome
lines: Only the Capitoline Hill holds out.

cards.title: The Appian Way
lines: The first great Roman road, and the first aqueduct.

cards.title: Carthage destroyed
lines: Rome now rules the Mediterranean.

cards.title: The Ides of March
lines: Julius Caesar is murdered in the Senate.

cards.title: Augustus, first emperor
lines: "I found Rome a city of brick and left it a city of marble."

cards.title: The Great Fire
lines: Ten of the fourteen districts burn. Nero rebuilds.

cards.title: The empire at its largest
lines: From Scotland to Iraq, ruled from this city.

cards.title: A million people
lines: The largest city the world has ever seen.

cards.title: A new capital
lines: Constantine moves the emperor to Constantinople.

cards.title: The end of the Western Empire
lines: The last emperor in the West is deposed.

cards.title: Plague and floods
lines: Fewer than 50,000 people live inside walls built for a million.

cards.title: Charlemagne
lines: Crowned emperor in Old St Peter's on Christmas Day.

cards.title: The Normans
lines: Allies of the Pope burn much of the city.

cards.title: The Popes leave
lines: The papacy moves to Avignon. Rome falls to ~17,000 people.

cards.title: The Popes return
lines: Rome starts to grow again, around the Vatican.

cards.title: The Sack of Rome
lines: Charles V's unpaid troops loot the city for months.

cards.title: Trevi Fountain
lines: Finished after 30 years of work.

cards.title: Napoleon
lines: French troops arrive. The Pope is taken prisoner.

cards.title: March on Rome
lines: Mussolini takes power.

cards.title: Liberation
lines: Allied troops enter Rome on 4 June 1944.
